sinopsis.es: El viento es fuerte y aúlla sobre las dunas, en el litoral del extremo sur de Brasil. La rutina de un pueblo de pescadores se transforma con la llegada de un forastero, en una jornada trágica de pasiones y violencia.
sinopsis.en: The wind is strong and howls over the dunes. The setting is the coast of the extreme South of Brazil. The routine of a fishing village is transformed by the arrival of a foreigner, in this film that is considered the first fictional feature with synchronized sound produced in the south of the country. With nods to codes of Italian neorealism, in a social portrait of profound rawness, filmed in high-contrast and stunning black and white compositions, Salomão Scliar turns the Gaucho landscapes into the setting for a tragic journey of passion and violence. (G.B.)
